argv: شارع الحبيب بورقيبة Avenue Habib Bourguiba +216 76 452 100

output.input: شارع الحبيب بورقيبة Avenue Habib Bourguiba +216 76 452 100

scripts.source: Unicode Character Database: Scripts.txt, ScriptExtensions.txt, PropertyValueAliases.txt

phones.matcher: PhoneNumberMatcher, leniency VALID (only numbers valid for their region are reported)

notes: Suggested facts clues are printed, never run. --script is a SOFT clue (Unicode CLDR): match or unknown only, it never excludes a country.

Script counting: Common/Inherited characters are not counted. A character shared by several scripts (ScriptExtensions.txt) is credited to the listed script with the most characters already in the text (this tie-break is the toolkit's rule, not Unicode's); if none of its scripts is present it is reported as shared_unresolved.
